brief: Holds named looks for a table layout, four built in and any you create, each a set of widths, padding and border characters.
detail: The built-in themes are Default (rounded box-drawing borders), Simple and Compact (plain plus and dash characters), and Elegant (square box-drawing corners). ApplyTheme sets the theme's settings and border characters and recomputes the layout. Like the other managers it works on a copy of the config it is given, readable as its oConfig attribute.
